content.text: If you just typed "car detailing near me" into your phone, you're probably staring at a list of shops in Duncan or Nanaimo wondering which one is actually worth your Saturday. I get that search a lot, and my answer is usually the same: don't drive anywhere. I bring the full setup to your driveway in Duncan, Cobble Hill, Mill Bay, or wherever you're parked in the Cowichan Valley, and the Full Detail package is the one most people end up booking because it covers the car top to bottom in one visit.
What's Actually in the Full Detail

A lot of places slap the word "detail" on a $40 rinse and call it a day. That's not what this is. Full Detail combines the entire exterior process with a full interior deep clean, and it runs from $219 for a sedan, $249 for an SUV, and $279 for a truck. Here's what that actually buys you, not just a wipe-down.

items: Foam pre-soak and two-bucket hand wash to lift dirt without swirling the paint
Iron decontamination and clay bar to pull embedded brake dust and road grime out of the clear coat
Wheels, wheel wells, and tires cleaned and dressed
Interior vacuum including under the seats and trunk, plus carpet and mat shampoo
Dash, console, doors, and vents wiped down and UV-protected
Leather or cloth seats conditioned or shampooed depending on your interior
Interior and exterior glass cleaned streak-free
Spray wax or sealant applied to finish the paint with a few months of protection

content.text: Why Mobile Beats Driving to a Shop

When people search car detailing near me, most of what comes up means dropping your car off for the day and figuring out a ride home. I set up right where your car already is, whether that's your driveway in Duncan, a parking spot in Chemainus, or your place out toward Lake Cowichan. I bring my own water and power, so there's no hose or outlet needed on your end. You get the same result as a shop detail, minus the wasted afternoon.
How Long It Takes and What to Expect

A Full Detail on a sedan usually takes about 3 to 4 hours, longer for a truck with a heavier interior or a lot of pet hair. I'll walk the car with you before I start so we're on the same page about problem areas, whether that's sap stuck to the hood from parking under trees near Cowichan Bay or salt residue tracked in from a Maple Bay boat launch. Nothing gets rushed just to hit a time slot.

Full Detail makes the most sense if it's been a few months since your last real clean, if you're selling the car and want it to show well, or if you just want to stop feeling embarrassed every time someone hops in. If your car's in decent shape and you mainly need the outside refreshed, the Exterior Detail on its own starts at $89 for a sedan. But if the inside has crumbs in the seams and the outside has that dull, grimy look after a summer of gravel roads and salt air out toward Crofton, Full Detail is the one that actually resets the car instead of just making it look okay from ten feet away.

Ready to book, or just want a real quote instead of a vague online estimate? Call or text 250-709-1371 and I'll get you a price based on your actual vehicle and set you up with a time that works. Free quotes, no pressure.
